paragraphs.text:
Sylvia has already been swept out of reach. Swimming strongly, 
you manage to reach Norman. You grab him by the collar of his 
leather jacket and drag him to shore.

Norman has lost 2D8 hit points from drowning. If he is still alive, 
you may make a First Aid roll: if you succeed, restore 1D3 of his hit 
points. If Norman is dead, go to 67. If he survives, you start for Fort 
McDonald; go to 279.
